frameworkNotes.plainHtml: Use the CDN or local files and add class="aui" to body or an embedded wrapper.
frameworkNotes.php: Include the CSS/JS from the shared PHP layout/template; Armsys UI requires no PHP package.
frameworkNotes.laravel: Include CDN/local assets in the Blade layout, or import the npm package from the project's frontend entry file.
frameworkNotes.dotnet: Place the assets under wwwroot or use the versioned CDN URLs from the Razor layout.
frameworkNotes.go: Serve the assets as static files or use the versioned CDN URLs from html/template layouts.
frameworkNotes.vueNuxt: Import the CSS globally and load the JS once on the client when data-attribute interactions are needed.
frameworkNotes.wordpress: Enqueue armsys-ui.css and armsys-ui.js from a custom theme/plugin and use normal semantic PHP template markup.
